## Intuition

<!-- The idea in plain words and one diagram, before any notation. Where a
trading-infrastructure analogue exists (FIX sequence numbers vs nonces, four-eyes
approval vs quorum, clearing vs netting), state it and state where it breaks. -->

```{python}
#| label: fig-intuition
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "One sentence stating what the figure shows."
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 1.0
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

steps = ["Input", "Step", "Output"]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 1.0))
for i, label in enumerate(steps):
    ax.text(i, 0, label, ha="center", va="center",
            bbox={"boxstyle": "round,pad=0.4", "fc": "white", "ec": "#2a78d6"})
for i in range(len(steps) - 1):
    ax.annotate("", xy=(i + 0.72, 0), xytext=(i + 0.28, 0), arrowprops={"arrowstyle": "->"})
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, len(steps) - 0.5)
ax.set_ylim(-0.5, 0.5)
ax.axis("off")
plt.show()
```
